api_policy.browser_api: typed product API, not generic MCP passthrough
api_policy.write_contract_rule: Future product API and MCP adapters call one shared narrow business service; no duplicated business rules.

tenant_context_policy.authoritative_source: server-verified session, actor assignment, and server-owned resource mapping
tenant_context_policy.launch: one CARR tenant; Joe and Dell only

sponsor_runtime_identity_policy.separation_rule: Organization tenant constrains data, sponsoring human selects one matching personal brain, runtime principal owns agent attribution, and the session capability profile constrains actions. None substitutes for another.
sponsor_runtime_identity_policy.joe_rule_resolution: Joe-sponsored Codex or Claude resolves shared plus Joe-personal; current verified artifact evidence declares 144 shared and 30 Joe-personal.
sponsor_runtime_identity_policy.dell_rule_resolution: Dell-sponsored Codex or Claude resolves shared plus the fresh Dell-personal artifact; an explicit zero is valid only after successful scope and version resolution.
sponsor_runtime_identity_policy.unsponsored_rule_resolution: Background or otherwise unsponsored agents receive active shared rules and/or explicit server-attached job rules, report personal_brain_scope none with personal_rule_count zero, and cannot claim a human sponsor or humanOnly capability. Null personal scope/count is reserved for missing or ambiguous resolution when a sponsor was expected.
sponsor_runtime_identity_policy.failure_semantics: Missing or ambiguous personal scope returns PERSONAL_SCOPE_REQUIRED or PERSONAL_SCOPE_AMBIGUOUS with resolution status Unknown and null personal count; never a misleading successful zero.
sponsor_runtime_identity_policy.non_escalation: Personal rules cannot select tenant, grant or widen capability, cross-load another partner brain, silently promote themselves, or replace runtime attribution.
sponsor_runtime_identity_policy.parity: Connector/store and generated fallback resolve the same partner brain, version, shared count, and personal count.

allowed: seat-safe display identity and notification preferences

endpoint_contract_defaults.idempotency_or_read_semantics: safe GET; no state change; cache identity includes server tenant, authenticated principal, and exact scope

endpoint_contract_defaults.telemetry: safe server tenant, operation ID, outcome, duration, freshness, correlation ID; no payload
endpoint_contract_defaults.rollback_implication: disable read-model feature flag or revert projection; canonical records unchanged
